The maintainer chose option A on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2270's blocker: the platform resolves these two reference classes against the artifact — this card's Ask, unchanged — rather than HotCRM moving the flows or the dataset. Director brief: https://claude.ai/artifact/DAfU6jpbkvmgLpZUgu5RJM (card 1).

Two notes for the executing seat, from the brief: (1) the scope is same-artifact only — a flow or dataset that **no** package of the artifact defines stays refused exactly as today; cross-artifact resolution belongs to #25403's ADR, not here; (2) include one booted measurement that a sibling package's flow starts from the action and a sibling package's dataset binds in the widget, because the HotCRM experiment kept both in the app package and measured only the author-time checks. hotcrm#2270 unblocks on a **released** `@objectstack/*` carrying this, not on the merge. The grade is triage's (now p2; the filer suggested p1); the maintainer can change it in one word.
